remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained 1,128 sq. ft. single-family home offering 3 nice-sized bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. The spacious layout features a large living room, comfortable dining room, and functional kitchen, providing plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. Several important updates provide added peace of mind, including a complete tear-off and new roof approximately 2 years old, updated 100 AMP electrical, some PEX plumbing, and glass block basement windows. The basement has also been professionally structurally secured with new I-beam supports and plates. The home has been well cared for by a long-term tenant, making this a great opportunity for an investor seeking a well-maintained rental property. A detached 1-car garage provides additional parking, storage, and convenience. With its spacious living areas, valuable updates, detached garage, and established rental history, this property offers solid investment potential and is ready for its next owner. A great opportunity for an investor or owner-occupant looking for a well-maintained home with important updates already completed! Offers reviewed as they come!
